The power of 10 minutes before school. ⏰ Those ten minutes go with him all day.

Ezra is eight. Mom puts her phone away, and the countdown starts:
1️⃣ Full attention. Eyes on him. 👀
2️⃣ A longer hug. Let that little body soak it in. 🤗
3️⃣ Speak life. "You've got this!"
4️⃣ Ask one real question. It opens a door. 🚪
5️⃣ Repair it. "I'm sorry I snapped."
6️⃣ Mistakes are okay. You don't have to be perfect.
7️⃣ Leave feeling loved, however today goes. ❤️

Then he walks through the school doors, and she can't follow. But at 10:15 he still feels that hug. At 11:30 his painting goes wrong, and he starts again. 🌈 At 12:30 he sits beside the new kid. ❤️ And at 3:00: "Mom, can I tell you something?"

"The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in from this time forth and forevermore." Psalm 121:8 (ESV) 🙏 You walk him there for one school day. God walks with him forever.

Ten minutes won't fix everything. But it changes how your child faces the day. ❤️ And for a worried child, the school door can be the hardest part.
